claim: Optional controls can be activated and deactivated concurrently, through an asynchronous process; up to 100 control-related operations can be in progress at a time, in total, whether called from the console or from an API.

qualifiers.scope: AWS Control Tower optional control operations, console and API combined

evidence.quote: Up to one hundred (100) control-related operations at a time can be in progress, in total, no matter if they are called from the console or from an API.
Optional controls can be activated and deactivated concurrently, through an asynchronous process.
